issues.description: The problem statement requires calling the external function `exit_func` with an integer status code, but the solution calls `exit_func` without pushing any argument onto the stack (missing status-code parameter). This contradicts the specification and leaves students unclear about the required calling sequence for program termination.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution conform to the requirement by passing a status code before the call, e.g., `push dword 0` followed by `call exit_func` (and document the expected calling convention if needed).
